subject: EntryGate: admin invite & API key playbook
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
To: Arbor Health Onboarding <onboarding@arborhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: EntryGate kickoff — admin invites & API key seeds

Hi Laura / Arbor onboarding team,

Thanks for confirming the sandbox workspace. To keep the first-week activation tight, I put together a short playbook for the initial entry gate: which admin accounts to seed, how we provision API keys for environments, and the invite cadence for project owners. Highlights:

- Seed two admin users (ORG_ADMIN) for initial provisioning; recommend one platform admin + one security contact.
- Create a separate service project for ingestion and issue an API key with restricted scope for dev/test.
- Invite end-user project owners after API key is validated (day 2).
- Documented checklist attached: entrygate-invite-checklist.xlsx

Quick asks from our side:
1) Who should be the initial ORG_ADMIN (name + email)?
2) Do you have a preferred key rotation policy we should align to for the sandbox?
3) Any strict IP allowlist or VPC peering requests before we seed keys?

If you prefer, we can run a 30-min call tomorrow to walk through the checklist and do the admin seed live. Monica will lead the hands-on session and Ben will coordinate the API key generation so we can keep the token lifecycle tidy.

Thanks,

Sofia Ivanova
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0142

Attachments: entrygate-invite-checklist.xlsx

From: Laura Chen <laura@arborhealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir.rao@arborhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EntryGate kickoff — admin invites & API key seeds

Thanks Sofia — this looks good. I looped in Samir (security) and our onboarding address. For the asks:

1) Initial ORG_ADMIN candidates: Samir Rao (samir.rao@arborhealth.com) and Laura Chen (laura@arborhealth.com). Samir will own the security contact.
2) Key rotation: we currently rotate service keys every 90 days for production; for sandbox / staging we can accept a 180-day cadence.
3) We need the service key restricted by CIDR for our staging environment (IP range 35.192.0.0/14) — is that possible for sandbox?

Samir — are you available for the walkthrough tomorrow at 11am PT?

Best,
Laura
Head of Engineering | Arbor Health
laura@arborhealth.com

Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EntryGate kickoff — admin invites & API key seeds

Thanks Laura — good to have Samir onboard. Short answers inline and a proposed lightweight MAP below.

- CIDR restriction: yes, we can add an allowlist for the sandbox key; we'll apply the 35.192.0.0/14 you provided. For tighter isolation we can also use a per-key VPC egress rule but that takes slightly longer to validate.
- Rotation: we'll seed the key with a 180-day TTL for sandbox; Ben will add a reminder in the HubSpot deal to review before cutover.

Proposed mutual action plan (timeline):
Day 0 (today): Seed ORG_ADMIN accounts (Samir, Laura).
Day 0 (after seed): Create service project and generate sandbox API key (CIDR-restricted).
Day 1: Validation — run a small end-to-end call from Arbor staging to confirm token scope and latency.
Day 2: Invite project owners (3 users) and hand off role matrix.

Monica will run the Day 0 session. Ben, can you generate a temporary sandbox key and include the restrict-by-IP setting? Karthik, please note any infra prerequisites if we need a VPC egress rule.

If that schedule works I can send the calendar invite for tomorrow 11am PT.

Cheers,
Sofia

Subject: Re: EntryGate kickoff — admin invites & API key seeds

Great — confirmed for tomorrow 11am PT. I attached a lightweight Role Matrix (arbor-onboard-roles-v1.pdf) that maps the minimum permissions we recommend for day-0 seeds. Key notes:

- ORG_ADMIN (Samir, Laura): full org-level visibility, can invite users, approve billing.
- PROJECT_OWNER: can create projects, rotate keys in project scope.
- SERVICE_ACCOUNT (for ingestion): token-scoped to the ingestion project, no org-level permissions.

Ben — my ask for the call: please create the sandbox API key with the CIDR allowlist and tag it inline as: sandbox/ARB-2093/initial. We'll revoke and re-issue with production-scoped keys later.

I'll run the seed checklist during the call and capture action items directly into the Drive link Sofia included.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.ai

Attachments: arbor-onboard-roles-v1.pdf
